name: cream-soda-android
description: Cream Soda launcher for Android: the server on the phone (Capacitor + Node.js for Mobile Apps)

scripts.build: npm run fonts && vite build && node scripts/prepare-node.mjs
scripts.add: npm run build && cap add android && npm run icons && node scripts/patch-plugins.mjs && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-plugins.mjs && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
